rows.grounds: adverbial form indicating location and addition
vocative address to the named demon
compound naming the addressed figure as chief of demons

items.question: What will the speaker do for Kaiṭabha, the demon chief, even there?
items.inference: The verse presents a direct promise to speak further to Kaiṭabha, the demon chief, in that place.
uncertainties: The exact doctrinal content of the promised speech is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: There too, hear: I will speak, O Kaiṭabha, chief of demons.
